'''October 2000 Milwaukee tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Egomania Comics, Milwaukee, Wisconsin on 21 October 2000. It is known from Evan Fitzgerald's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1393">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-27-egomania-comics-10-21-2000d1393/ egomania-comics-10-21-2000], DeckTech (Evan "Lorax" Fitzgerald, 27 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-27-egomania-comics-10-21-2000d1393/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 21 October 2000
* '''Site:''' Egomania Comics, Milwaukee, Wisconsin
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
